01 — About

Two Aggies, one Gemini club.

We're a student club at Texas A&M powered by the Google Student Ambassador Program — which, right now, means the two of us. We run workshops, build nights, and anything else that gets people making things with Gemini.

Mostly we work alongside other students to find new ways to use Gemini — for studying, for class projects, or just for everyday life.

Any class year, any major, any level of experience — all welcome.

Powered by the Google Student Ambassador Program ↗

02 — What we do

Three things, on repeat, all semester.

01

Workshops

learn it properly

Hands-on sessions on the Gemini API, Google AI Studio and NotebookLLM — taught by members, not slides.

02

Build nights

ship something small

Bring a laptop and a half-formed idea. Leave with a working prototype and people who want to test it.

03

Speakers

hear from the field

Engineers and founders building on Google's AI products, answering the questions a lecture never will.

03 — Join us

Come hang out with us.

Meetings are free and open to every major. Say hi in the Discord, or see what we're up to on Instagram.
